cases.setup_script:
ADAPTER_SOURCE=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-sftp-ssh-r3.py
ADAPTER_TARGET=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-adapter
/usr/bin/install -m 0755 "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET"
/usr/bin/sha256sum "$ADAPTER_TARGET" > "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
/usr/bin/stat -c "mode=%a uid=%u" "$ADAPTER_TARGET" >> "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
read -r adapter_sha adapter_name < "$HOME/adapter-control.txt"
[[ $adapter_sha == 18b2920ad89a6f9a85bb595147ad9ea087c794d9b1956673783770c3d540df3b && -x "$ADAPTER_TARGET" ]] && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET" || { echo "CONTROL-FAILED adapter copy/hash/mode"; exit 98; }
H=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-adapter
FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT="$HOME/control-remote"
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"control","deny":false}' > "$HOME/sftp-config.json"
mkdir -p "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" remote
printf 'control contents\n' > "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT/control-name"
printf 'pwd\nls\n' > "$HOME/control.batch"
[[ -x /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server && -x "$H" ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED missing executable'; exit 98; }
"$H" fixture pwd > "$HOME/control-command.out"
[[ $(/usr/bin/cat "$HOME/control-command.out") == "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" ]] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED shell endpoint'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/sftp -b "$HOME/control.batch" -S "$H" fixture > "$HOME/control-sftp.out" 2> "$HOME/control-sftp.err"
/usr/bin/grep -Fq 'control-name' "$HOME/control-sftp.out" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED OpenSSH SFTP endpoint'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/grep -Fq "$FIXTURE_REMOTE_ROOT" "$HOME/control-sftp.out" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED remote pwd'; exit 98; }
printf '%s\n' '{"phase":"case","deny":false}' > "$HOME/sftp-case-config.json"
/usr/bin/install -m 0600 "$HOME/sftp-case-config.json" "$HOME/sftp-config.json"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/sftp-case-config.json" "$HOME/sftp-config.json" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED configuration copy'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/cp "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl" "$HOME/control-invocations.jsonl"
: > "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl"
cases.candidate_script:
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
H=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-adapter
export BASHSSH_OPENSSH_BIN="$H"
builtin sftp --openssh -b commands.batch fixture > "$HOME/client.stdout" 2> "$HOME/client.stderr"
rc=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY2'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/parity-home')
e=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'sftp-invocations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
stages=[x['event'] for x in e]
valid=('invoked' in stages and 'configured' in stages and 'error' not in stages)
valid=valid and ('command' in stages or 'sftp-server' in stages)
print('peer-stage=observed' if valid else 'peer-stage=unobserved')
PY2
